description: C4 (decision C4-5): the settlement attacked - once its hall stands roofed (Last Hearth at tier 1), the Rimward come for it: shieldmen, pikemen and archers over the upland from the east, hunting the Hearth's folk while a rimkin warleader holds the giant, and the folk run for the hall. A protect objective (its six folk: three dead lose it). The tier matters: from tier 2 the stone ring's four archers loose at the raiders beside the giant, from tier 3 six and the beacon's great bow (SettlementGarrison), and every raider they drop is one fewer at the folk. Stage 6 and up, ten minutes after the last ended, again and again until it is beaten back once (the beacon waits on that), then at most three runs in all (Cgate), never while the Hearth is hostile. Defended: 200 XP the first time, and the beacon's project may be raised; fell: the dead are mourned, and newcomers take their places once the giant is away (the settlement's mends).

start_text: The Rimward are coming for Last Hearth!
respawn_text: The Rimward still raid Last Hearth.

defended.text: Last Hearth holds. Its folk come out of the hall to see the raiders run.

fell.text: The Rimward broke into Last Hearth: its folk mourn their dead.
